envelope.description: Persist diagnostics through both task-review host routes

body.title: Persist diagnostics through both task-review host routes
body.summary: Add optional host-owned failureDiagnostics to the existing attempt response and connect the native callback/error fallback to daemon serial persistence. Extend the existing controller activity exchange for diagnostics with task/phase/owner/execution/sequence checks. Keep shared attribution diagnostic evidence once per attempt phase and assessment diagnostics per selected task, preserving old checkpoints, ordinary result schemas and immutable history.
acceptanceChecks: Daemon and controller paths durably retain equivalent diagnostic snapshots in the existing checkpoint; no new recovery file or diagnostic RPC is introduced.
Diagnostics never renew inactivity, complete tasks, change prior results or cross owner/execution/task fences; identical accepted exchange replay is idempotent.
Attribution errors are stored once at phase scope; assessment errors require a selected task. Save/budget failures surface honestly without false acknowledgment or loss of already accepted feedback.
Historical checkpoints/CRs without diagnostics remain unchanged and readable; model-authored TaskReviewResult/native schemas do not request or accept host diagnostic fields.

tests.name: Old checkpoint unchanged; diagnostics optional and host-owned, absent from model result schema
Shared attribution diagnostics stored once and projected only to applicable selected scope
Controller diagnostic exchange preserves ownership/sequence replay and never renews inactivity
Writer failure does not falsely acknowledge diagnostics; accepted feedback survives later wrapper failure
